description: This file contains implementation of cryptographic big number context management, including stack handling and context allocation/freeing functions for BIGNUM objects, used in cryptographic computations within OpenSSL.

classes.name: BN_STACK
classes.description: A stack structure for managing indexes into BIGNUM array during context operations.

classes.name: bignum_ctx
classes.description: Opaque structure managing BIGNUM stack, context stack, and related state for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: BN_STACK_cleanup
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a BN_STACK.

methods.name: BN_STACK_push
methods.description: Pushes an index onto the BN_STACK.

methods.name: BN_STACK_pop
methods.description: Pops an index from the BN_STACK.
